why_not: The shadow ledger and fail-closed session gate sound disciplined, but you are asking for $49 a month with zero published multi-year net-of-slippage backtest results against a random baseline.
After getting burned by an unverified options Discord last quarter, I will not put a card down on a new scanner until there is a public track record and independent reviews on Reddit or Trustpilot.
At $49 a month on top of my TradingView plan, it is too expensive for a $10k-$50k swing account when I can code basic divergence and Stage filters in Pine Script.
Almost $600 a year eats a big chunk of a smaller swing account, and without real backtest proof I am not paying more than Finviz Elite.
I already pay $35 a month for TradingView Plus and run free scans in thinkorswim Stock Hacker, so adding a $49 subscription on top just duplicates work I already automate.
I already run custom scans in thinkorswim Stock Hacker and Python scripts after 16:00 ET, and the pitch provides zero backtested edge metrics to prove this is better than my setup.
I already pay $35 a month for TradingView Plus and track my swings in a spreadsheet, and I am not adding $49 more for quotes that may still be 10 to 20 minutes delayed.
I am comfortable with TradingView Plus at $35 and my spreadsheet, and I do not want to juggle another $49 monthly auto-renewal that feels redundant.

Scanning 500 stocks around a full-time job takes hours I do not have, so having invalidation levels, regime breadth, and Telegram alerts ready before the bell justifies trying $49 for a month.
